text:
maria: Planning airgap delivery for Private vpc onprem tomorrow night. Need final escort/cargo rotation plan and deploybot window. Target cutover 2026-03-25 03:00-04:00 UTC. :ship:

alex: ack. which installer bundle are we shipping?

maria: shipping `redwood-installer-private-2.1.0+rev3.tar.gz` — contains signed submanifests. Cosign signatures already attached.

sanjay: FYI we've pinned runtime image to `redwood/runtime:2.1.0-quant-p2` for this delivery. Rollback candidate is `2.1.0-quant-p1` (previous pin).

jamie: ops checklist: buckets pre-signed, transport manifest ready, offline mirror prereqs validated. Need cargo ETA from logistics and KMS handoff window.

qa-liz: running final smoke on the staging delta bundle now. Will post failing prompt cases within 30m if any.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @maria for channel `eng-releases` — start: 3467890320 (2026-03-25T03:00:20Z), expected duration 20m. Canary nodes: 3/20. Auto-fallback: enabled to `2.1.0-quant-p1` on health fail.

maria: Ops: confirm escort windows and whether we need to hold the transport until cosign rotation completes. Also confirm that the offline checksum matches the manifest.

opsbot: Transport escrow created: escrow-id `ESCROW-20260325-17`. Transport ETA: 2026-03-25T02:15Z UTC to on-prem staging. KMS wrap key in HSM scheduled to be rotated at 2026-03-25T02:40Z UTC.

alex: re: checksums — here's the quick verify: `sha256: 3f7b2a9c8d...5a1e` for the bundle, manifest: `manifests/2.1.0/rev3/manifest.json`. QA please confirm match.

qa-liz: checksum matches on my side. Smoke suite passed basic prompt/latency, failing one eval in rerank stage — investigating.

maria: please post the failing case inline when you have it. If it's a policy false positive we may still ship. If it's a regression in tokenization we'll pause.

qa-liz: failing snippet: "rerank": expected top doc id 42 but got 56 for prompt 'policy guidelines update'. Attaching stack: `IndexError: KV cache mismatch` — possibly a packaging edge.

sanjay: KV cache mismatch could be due to kernel selection differences between p2 builds. I will run the exact runtime binary locally against the bundle and produce a repro.

maria: hold deploybot while we triage? We have 45m until cutover.

alex: suggest two-step: 1) pause deploybot scheduling for 15m; 2) if root cause not resolved, ship with canary disabled and narrow canary to 1 node with manual monitoring, otherwise rollback to `2.1.0-quant-p1`.

deploy-bot: Deploy window paused by @maria — status: HOLD. Next scheduled action in 15m (3467891035).

sanjay: repro found: packaging script dropped a stale `kv_cache_config.json` mismatch. Fix is to regenerate bundle with `--kv-config=latest`. I'll produce `rev4` in ~10m and re-run cosign.

maria: ok push rev4 if cosign completes before 02:55 UTC. If not, we proceed with narrowed canary and manual rollback plan.

opsbot: Note — airgap transport manifest requires explicit `escrow-id` annotation when swapping bundles. If we replace with rev4, update `transport/escort.yaml` before sealing.

jamie: logistics: Escort team can delay pickup by 20m if needed. We have a backup courier available at 02:45 UTC.

qa-liz: re-run smoke on rev4 when available. If clean, I'll sign-off with `QA:pass` and list the regression tests run.

sanjay: uploading rev4 bundle now: `redwood-installer-private-2.1.0+rev4.tar.gz`. New sha256: `a8c5d1f9...e4b2`. Cosign step in progress.

deploy-bot: Cosign verification succeeded for artifact `redwood-installer-private-2.1.0+rev4.tar.gz` — signatures by `signer-release@redwood.com`.

qa-liz: rev4 smoke ✅. KV cache regression resolved. QA:pass. Running full regression but nothing blocking for cutover.

maria: Great. Update transport manifest with escrow `ESCROW-20260325-17` and set deploybot to proceed. Keep canary at 3 nodes, monitor keys, and alert channels `#incidents` and `#oncall`.

deploy-bot: Deploy resumed by @maria — start: 3467890320 (unchanged). Canary: 3 nodes. Auto-fallback: `2.1.0-quant-p1`. Will post progress updates.

opsbot: Handoff note: courier ETA confirmed 2026-03-25T02:40Z; handler on site `glass-ops`. KMS rotation completed at 02:40 UTC.

alex: post-deploy checks: 1) cosign sigs verified on target, 2) manifest checksum matches offline mirror, 3) latency p50/p95 within baseline, 4) no rerank regressions. If any fail, cut traffic and rollback to `2.1.0-quant-p1`.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout update: 3/3 canary nodes healthy. No errors in last 5m. Rolling to 20 nodes.

maria: monitoring channels open. Ops, SRE, QA standby for the next 30m.

qa-liz: running validation queries. All good so far.

sanjay: looking at telemetry — token step defaults fine. No KV surprises after rev4.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: 20/20 nodes active. Health: OK. Final artifact pinned at `2.1.0+rev4`.

maria: Excellent. Closing transport window. Will file release notes and update release-channel with artifact pins and cosign fingerprints. Thanks everyone. :tada:
